title: The vanishing and base change statements hold for the constant sheaf Z/ellZ on a smooth curve
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies the vanishing, finiteness, base change and surjectivity statements for the constant coefficient sheaf Z/ellZ on a smooth curve over an algebraically closed field (statement lines 15376-15383). The proof (proof lines 15385-15414) reduces to a smooth curve, treats the prime-to-characteristic case through the projective and affine computations with the invariance of genus and punctures and the affineness of punctured curves, and the characteristic case through the vanishing and finiteness lemmas in characteristic p. H2: two case analyses with named inputs, written out.
